newsitem.title: UK: BA Cargo says peformance, productivity up.
newsitem.headline: BA Cargo says peformance, productivity up.

text.p: British Airways World Cargo's performance standards and productivity are improving, managing director Kevin Hatton said in a statement.

"Our Change Programme for World Cargo is working... and the successful integration of our airside operation, which gives World Cargo control of freight deliveries to aircraft side at Heathrow, will support this further," he added.

"Clearly we still have a long way to go to fulfil the service delivery expectations of our customers, but I am encouraged by these initial signs of improvement and the growing recognition by our staff of the need for change," he said.
Industry sources said Hatton's comments were a reply to criticism of BA Cargo operations -- especially at Heathrow -- by some UK-based and foreign users.
